test_command_bypass_active_session: test that slash commands like /stop, /new, /reset bypass the active-session guard instead of being queued
test_all_resolvable_commands_bypass_guar: test that every registered slash command bypasses the Level-1 active-session guard when a session is active
test_non_bypass_still_queued: test that regular text messages and unknown commands are queued as pending when an agent is running
test_pending_command_safety_net: test that the safety net in _run_agent discards command text leaking into the pending queue
test_bypass_with_botname_suffix: test that Telegram-style @botname suffixes on slash commands still bypass the active-session guard
